items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I have to share a little — Don Menza said the same thing. He was at Fredonia. SUNY Fredonia. He said playing Dixieland was misdemeanor and playing bebop was a felony. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah right, okay. Right.

ctx.x: It is. It’s the School of the Arts or something like that and basically it’s all improvisation, whether it’s folk music or whatever, it’s an all-improvisational school now.
